description: A D_PDU whose header CRC fails is not a D_PDU: its EOT is not used, and the D_PDU after it is still found.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). Every received D_PDU is a single-segment NON-ARQ-DATA (type 7, address size 4, C_PDU ID as stated, reception window 20) whose segment is a DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU from SAP 9 to SAP 9 with U_PDU "hi". At 2000: a D_PDU from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.9 (C_PDU ID 1) encoded with EOT 4 whose EOT byte was then changed to 2, so its header CRC fails; then a good D_PDU (C_PDU ID 2) with EOT 10, end 7000. Had the corrupt EOT been used, the estimate would be 2000 + 1000 = 3000, before the burst end, and DCD would clear last. Burst end 4000: csma.vdcd_end 3000 ms, then rule 3 gives 3000 ms.
